title: AI agents and their tools · Level 3
slo: Identify the parts of an AI agent and the tasks an agent can help perform.

exercises.question_text: How can generated content be used in a work task?

options.text: As a starting point for further development
options.rationale: This is correct. Generated content can serve as a draft that people develop further.

options.text: Only as a final approved document
options.rationale: Generated content can be revised and developed further. It is not limited to an approved final document.
options.better_fit: This fits a document after its review and approval process.

options.rationale: Language detection identifies a document's language. It does not create a draft or other content.
options.better_fit: This fits determining the language of a document.

options.rationale: Information extraction identifies existing details in data. Generative AI creates new content for further work.
options.better_fit: This fits extracting fields from unstructured sources.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Generated content can provide a useful first draft.

exercises.question_text: Which abilities can an AI agent have? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: This is correct. Agents can reason about natural-language requests.
This is correct. Agents can generate natural-language responses.
This is correct. Agents can use tools to automate tasks.

options.error_type: Confuses an agent with a rule-based chatbot
options.rationale: Agents are not limited to fixed dialog rules. They can reason and respond to contextual conditions.
options.better_fit: This fits a rule-based chatbot with predefined dialog paths.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Agents can understand and generate language, then use tools to act.

exercises.question_text: The language model is the agent's job description that defines its behavior.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The agent's role could be confused with its reasoning capability.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Think of the language model as the brain and instructions as the job description.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Instructions define behavior; the language model supports understanding and reasoning.

exercises.question_text: Instructions set an AI agent's role and expected behavior.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The agent could operate without a clearly defined role.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Instructions are the system prompt that guides role and expected behavior.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Instructions act as the agent's job description.

exercises.question_text: The ___ is the brain of an AI agent.

parts.text: is the brain of an AI agent.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The selected component would not supply the agent's reasoning.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Instructions guide behavior and tools interact with the world; the language model provides language reasoning.

exercises.explanation: The large language model supplies the language understanding and reasoning used by the agent.

exercises.question_text: What can an AI assistant do for a human user?

options.rationale: This is correct. AI assistants help human users automate work.

options.error_type: Confuses an assistant with language detection
options.rationale: Language detection identifies a document's language. It does not describe an assistant's task-automation role.

options.error_type: Confuses an assistant with sentiment analysis
options.rationale: Sentiment analysis classifies the tone of text. It does not automate a user's broader work task.
options.better_fit: This fits analyzing opinions in text.

options.error_type: Confuses an assistant with computer vision
options.rationale: Object detection identifies items in an image. It is not the general role of an AI assistant.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Assistants support people by automating tasks.

exercises.question_text: A tool that sends an email or updates a calendar is an ___.

parts.text: A tool that sends an email or updates a calendar is an

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The capability would be misclassified as information access rather than task execution.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Knowledge tools access information; action tools perform tasks in the world.

exercises.explanation: Sending email and updating a calendar perform tasks, so they use an action tool.

exercises.question_text: What can generative-AI chatbots do? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: This is correct. Generative chatbots can answer questions from users.
This is correct. Generative chatbots can hold conversations.
This is correct. Their generative capability creates responses.
Generative chatbots can create responses beyond fixed dialogs. Fixed dialogs describe a rule-based approach.
options.better_fit: This fits a rule-based chatbot with predefined conversations.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Generative chatbots can answer, converse, and generate responses.

exercises.question_text: Arrange the pieces to form a correct statement.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The continuing relationship between role and behavior is obscured.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Start with instructions guiding behavior, then connect that guidance to the role they define.

exercises.correct_answer: Instructions guide behavior across each interaction by defining the agent's role
exercises.explanation: Instructions persist as standing guidance by defining the role that shapes behavior across interactions.

exercises.question_text: A customer-service agent must answer from company records and then send a confirmation email. Which tools are necessary for a reliable solution? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: This is correct. The database supplies the company-record information needed for the answer.
This is correct. Sending confirmation is an external action that requires an action tool.
Instructions are useful guidance but do not retrieve records or send messages. They do not satisfy either required operation.
options.better_fit: This fits defining the agent's role and behavior.

feedback.intrinsic: The customer may receive neither a record-based answer nor a confirmation email.
feedback.instructional: This decision requires a knowledge tool for records and an action tool for email.

options.rationale: A language model can understand and reason but cannot independently access company systems or send email. Both required interactions need tools.
options.better_fit: This fits language understanding and reasoning.

feedback.intrinsic: The response may sound helpful but lack records and no confirmation will be sent.
feedback.instructional: The model is the reasoning brain; tools connect the agent to information and actions.

exercises.explanation: Correct. A reliable solution needs both record access and an email action.

exercises.question_text: Generative AI can translate spoken audio between languages as one of its text content uses.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A team could choose a text-focused approach when it needs to process spoken audio.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Generative AI can translate text between languages. Speech translation handles spoken language.

exercises.explanation: Correct. This lesson's content use is text translation, while spoken translation is a speech capability.

options.text: Software that reasons, uses tools, and acts on context
options.rationale: This is correct. An AI agent combines language reasoning, tool use, and context-aware action.

options.text: A model that only creates new content
options.error_type: Confuses an agent with generative AI
options.rationale: Generating content is only one capability. This description omits tool use and context-aware task action.
options.better_fit: This fits generative AI used only to create text, images, or code.

options.text: A chatbot with fixed conversational dialogs
options.error_type: Confuses an agent with a rule-based chatbot
options.rationale: Fixed dialogs do not provide flexible reasoning and action. They are narrower than an AI agent.
options.better_fit: This fits a rule-based chatbot for predictable conversations.

options.error_type: Confuses an agent with a knowledge tool
options.rationale: A database stores or provides information. It does not reason about language or decide what action to take.
options.better_fit: This fits a knowledge tool an agent may consult.

exercises.explanation: Correct. An agent combines reasoning, tools, and context-aware action.
